title: Advanced Strings: KMP Pattern Matching
contract: Return the first match index of pattern in text, or −1. An empty pattern matches at 0.
optimal:
if(pattern.isEmpty())return 0;int[] lps=new int[pattern.length()];for(int i=1,len=0;i<pattern.length();){if(pattern.charAt(i)==pattern.charAt(len))lps[i++]=++len;else if(len>0)len=lps[len-1];else lps[i++]=0;emit("Build longest proper prefix/suffix lengths","lps",lps);}
for(int i=0,j=0;i<text.length();){if(text.charAt(i)==pattern.charAt(j)){i++;j++;if(j==pattern.length())return i-j;}else if(j>0)j=lps[j-1];else i++;emit("Reuse a matched border instead of restarting text","text index",i,"matched prefix",j);}return -1;
reasoning: At every possible start, compare characters until a mismatch or complete match.
The LPS table records the longest proper prefix also ending at each pattern position.
After a mismatch, fall back to a known matching border without moving the text pointer backward. Border lengths amortize the fallback work to linear time.
